#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Safely unpack a supplier tar archive below incoming/."""
import errno
import os
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/archive-member-safety
printf '%s\n' '--- incoming before tests ---'
if [ -e "$base/incoming" ]; then find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -printf '%y %p -> %l\n' | sort; else printf '%s\n' '(absent)'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- malicious rejection tests ---'
for name in absolute traversal symlink; do
  before=$(find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P|%y|%l\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
  set +e
  output=$("$base/bin/unpack" "$base/packages/$name.tar" 2>&1)
  status=$?
  set -e
  after=$(find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P|%y|%l\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
  printf '%s status=%s output=%s\n' "$name" "$status" "$output"
  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
  [ "$before" = "$after" ]
done
printf '%s\n' '--- protected and package hashes after rejection ---'
sha256sum "$base"/packages/*.tar "$base"/protected/*
printf '%s\n' '--- incoming after rejection tests ---'
find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -printf '%y %P -> %l\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
